name: Masterwork Silver Dagger
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 157, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 471
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 157, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 471
Aura no aura (nonmagical) CL
Slot none; Price 322 gp ; Weight 1 lb.
Description
As a masterwork weapon, this alchemical silver dagger has a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls (but not on damage rolls).
